note: What a server sends to put a champion on the field. It arrives on its own and also inside EnterSight. The header carries zero or names the object this is about; a client accepts either.

fields.name: champion
fields.note: The name the champion answers to, so later messages can name it.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: The client id of the player the champion belongs to. A client takes the champion carrying its own client id as its own.

fields.name: node
fields.note: What this carries is not recorded.

fields.name: between
fields.note: Unused; a server writes zero.

fields.name: side
fields.note: Not zero for side 100, zero for 200.

fields.name: bot
fields.note: Set where nobody holds it.

fields.name: after
fields.note: Unused; a server writes zero.

fields.name: spawnIndex
fields.note: Which of its side's starting places it begins at.

fields.name: skin
fields.note: Which look it wears.

fields.name: name
fields.note: What the seat holding it is called.

fields.name: asset
fields.note: The champion it is.

fields.name: skillLevel
fields.note: It has no effect.

fields.name: side
fields.note: Nonzero for side 100, zero for side 200.

fields.name: bot
fields.note: Nonzero where a bot plays the seat; its shown name is then the client's own bot name for asset, and name has no effect.

fields.name: rank
fields.note: It has no effect.

fields.name: spawnIndex
fields.note: Where the champion first stands and faces. From 0 to 5, its side's base position plus the offset the map sets for the side's head count (players and bots) and this index plus one, facing as the map sets for them. A client works out the head count itself, counting SpawnStart's bots in it. From 6 up, the base position itself, facing along +X. Movement or sight data replaces it.

fields.name: skin
fields.note: Which look it wears.

fields.name: name
fields.note: What the seat holding it is called. Written out in full and padded with zero bytes to the width above.

fields.name: asset
fields.note: The name the client loads its art and sound under, written and padded as above.

fields.name: stayDown
fields.note: How long it stays down, in seconds, where it is already down.

fields.name: downFor
fields.note: How long it has already been down, in seconds.

bits.name: down
bits.note: 0 alive; 1 dead but acting on (the state a champion that keeps acting after death is in), where stayDown and downFor have no effect; 2 down, having been down for downFor with stayDown left. A client takes 3 to 7 as 0.

bits.name: swap
bits.note: Set where the champion replaces another. Of no effect otherwise.

revisions.note: The champion takes the id in champion, not the header's; a client first removes any object holding that id. For the client's own seat, name also becomes its own player's name. A client drops the message while its map's navigation data is unloaded, as early in a reconnection.
